Short answer: Choose Shopify when products, inventory, shipping, and multiple sales channels are the main operation. Choose Squarespace when the site is mainly content with a smaller, simpler store.

What this means for your business

The question is not which homepage looks nicer. It is where inventory lives, how staff sell in person, what happens after an order, and how much platform work the owner wants.

What to watch

  • Inventory updated separately online and in the shop.
  • A needed app or add-on for every ordinary task.
  • Shipping, returns, pickup, or taxes discovered after launch.
  • A redesign that breaks the path regular customers already use.

Do this next

  1. Map one product from stock to sale to return.
  2. List in-person, pickup, shipping, and marketplace needs.
  3. Price the real plan, payment fees, apps, and hardware.
  4. Test the full purchase on a phone before choosing.

When Little Fight fits

We help a shop choose, connect, migrate, or build around the platform. We do not move a working store just to win a website project.

Get a plain-English second opinion

Sources and further reading

Checked August 13, 2026. Product features and rules can change, so use the linked source as the current word.

  • Shopify POS features — Official retail and inventory feature source.
  • Squarespace commerce plans — Current plan and commerce feature source.
